en.text:
Sword Kills grants 1 stack of 'Gathering Light'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Gathering Light benefits at 1|2|3|...|10 Stacks:

• ? Guard Resistance
• ? Guard Endurance
• 10%|20%|30%|...|100% increased lunge distance

Stowing the sword consumes all stacks, granting 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy per stack.
